issues.description: The problem requests sums of male and female inhabitants grouped by Regierungsbezirk (the name of the Regierungsbezirk). The solution groups by 'kreis' (county) but selects 'regierungsbezirk' in the SELECT list. This creates a structural mismatch: the GROUP BY column does not match the SELECT non-aggregated column as required. Students will be confused (and in strict SQL modes will get an error) because the provided solution groups by the wrong attribute relative to the task description.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution so the GROUP BY matches the requested grouping by 'regierungsbezirk'. For example: SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) FROM Gemeinde GROUP BY regierungsbezirk; Alternatively, if grouping by 'kreis' is intended, update the problem description to request grouping by 'kreis' and include 'kreis' in the SELECT list.
